name: zinput_play_damage_hit_effect
description: zInputDI::PlayDamageHitEffect stops the DamageHit DirectInput effect, computes the damage-source polar direction relative to the player camera direction, clamps gain to 0.25..1.0, applies the effect parameters, and starts the effect once.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the zInput force-feedback class/source-file pass so member-call shape, DirectInput provider calls, x87 fpatan scheduling, and /Ob1-era source shape can be compared together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42fc90 validates the thiscall effect-set receiver, DamageHit offset 0x10 null guard, DirectInput effect Stop/SetParameters/Start provider slots at vtable offsets 0x20/0x18/0x1c, source/camera atan2 direction math, one-wrap polar normalization, degree*100 conversion, DIEFFECT size 0x34, DIEFFECT flags 0x20, two axes, SetParameters flags 0x44, and gain clamp to the 0.25..1.0 range before scaling to 10000.

The native force-feedback directional smoke verifies the DamageHit member path stops the effect, writes directional DIEFFECT parameters, clamps a high gain to 10000, preserves the expected polar direction, and starts the effect once.
